::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/emails/send"}
#docs
Operator-initiated send (the per-record `Email` action) — the only create endpoint on this resource; every other email is produced by the engine. Renders the chosen type against a real record and sends immediately through the resolved transport, bypassing the outbox. Deliberately NOT gated on `email_config.enabled`: that flag governs automatic mail, and an operator pressing Send has already decided for this one message. Which record id is required depends on `type`: `invoice` for `invoice_sent`/`payment_request`, `credit_note` for `credit_note_sent`, `customer` for `payment_method_request`. A missing one is a 400 rather than a half-filled send. A relay refusing the message is reported as `ok: false` with a 200.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | `string` | **yes** | The email type to send. One of `invoice_sent`, `payment_request`, `payment_method_request`, `credit_note_sent`. |
| `customer` | `string` | no | Customer id (cus_…). Required for `payment_method_request`; derived from the record otherwise. |
| `invoice` | `string` | no | Invoice id (inv_…). Required for `invoice_sent` and `payment_request`. |
| `credit_note` | `string` | no | Credit note id (cn_…). Required for `credit_note_sent`. |
| `to` | `string` | no | Override the recipient. Defaults to the customer's billing email; does not change what is stored on the customer. |
| `note` | `string` | no | The operator's covering message, rendered as {{note}}. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `email_send`. One of `email_send`. |
| `ok` | `boolean` | True if the email was sent. |
| `error` | `string` | Why sending failed, when it did. |
| `transport` | `string` | How the email was sent. One of `console`, `smtp`, `esp`. |
| `email_id` | `string` | The id of the email message that was created. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Send attempted |
| `400` | Missing record, unknown type, or no recipient |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/emails/send" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "type": "invoice_sent"
  }'
```
